title: Pensioners: life certificate by face scan till Nov 30

slides.head: Pensioners: life certificate by face scan till Nov 30
What happened
slides.body: SBI at its local head office and India Post Payments Bank at the General Post Office are running camps.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Pensioners must submit a life certificate; face authentication lets them do it on a smartphone.

slides.head: Campaign ends
slides.body: Officials are also visiting super-senior and disabled pensioners at home to generate certificates.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Digital life certificates began in 2014 with biometric devices; face scan came later with MeitY and UIDAI.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Camps run until Nov 30 at SBI's local head office and the GPO. Ask: How many Hyderabad pensioners have filed digitally this month?

slides.head: Spill the tea, daily
slides.body: Hyderabad news in 30 seconds, with the numbers and the questions. Follow for tomorrow's drop: spillthetea.news

captions.instagram:
Pensioners: life certificate by face scan till Nov 30

The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare is running a Digital Life Certificate campaign in Hyderabad from Nov 1 to 30 using Aadhaar-based face authentication on Android phones.

Why it matters: Pensioners must submit a life certificate; face authentication lets them do it on a smartphone.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
